decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat that opponents will struggle to deal with. The deck includes card draw and counterspells to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's plans. By efficiently cycling through the deck and constantly interacting with the opponent's spells, the deck aims to quickly dominate the game and secure a win through its combo synergy.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through effects like Sylvan Library and Skeletal Scrying. It uses removal spells like Smother and Pernicious Deed to control the board, along with hand disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Duress. The deck also utilizes creatures like Spiritmonger and Terravore for threats while also having access to a toolbox of creatures through Living Wish. The mana base is built around generating both green and black mana efficiently, with utility lands like Treetop Village and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's resources.

The deck focuses on using cards like Replenish and Opalescence to quickly bring back enchantments from the graveyard and turn them into powerful threats. Parallax Wave and Attunement help fuel this combo while Decree of Silence provides control. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Abeyance and Seal of Cleansing, as well as card draw with Intuition and Frantic Search. The mana base is designed to support the strategy with lands like Ancient Tomb and Flooded Strand.

The deck focuses on quickly getting Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield and countering any threats or removal spells that may prevent the combo from going off. Using cards like Stifle to counter activated abilities and Counterspell to stop opposing spells, the goal is to win the game by playing a large creature for a small cost, gaining a significant advantage over the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells to help find the necessary pieces for the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and creature cards. The strategy involves quickly dropping low-cost creatures like Mogg Fanatic and Grim Lavamancer, while also utilizing cards like Pyrostatic Pillar and Black Vise to punish the opponent's hand size and life total. By maintaining constant pressure and keeping the opponent on the defensive, the goal is to win the game as quickly as possible before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to create a powerful card advantage engine by playing multiple enchantments that allow the player to draw extra cards. By utilizing creatures like Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence, along with enchantments like Mirri's Guile and Sterling Grove, the player can continuously draw cards and set up their combo pieces. Once enough enchantments are in play, the player can then use cards like Opalescence and Replenish to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state and win the game.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on quickly and efficiently controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Hypnotic Specter, Duress, and Cabal Therapy. It also utilizes aggressive creatures like Nantuko Shade and Mishra's Factory to apply pressure and deal damage quickly. The deck includes removal spells like Smother, Diabolic Edict, and Chainer's Edict to deal with threats on the board. With a mix of targeted disruption, efficient creatures, and removal, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents in a fast-paced game.

The deck focuses on quickly bringing out the Phyrexian Dreadnought card and utilizing cards like Stifle and Foil to prevent opponents from countering its abilities. The deck also includes various card draw spells like Gush and Opt to help find the necessary combo pieces. It has a control aspect with counterspells like Counterspell and Thwart to disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of cards like Chain of Vapor and Peek provide additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and protect it from disruption while controlling the game.

The deck is centered around utilizing the Oath of Druids card to quickly summon powerful creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel. The deck also includes a number of control cards like Cataclysm, Swords to Plowshares, and Seal of Cleansing to deal with various threats. Mana acceleration is provided by Mox Diamond and Gemstone Mine, while land destruction is employed through cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The goal is to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and overwhelm them with powerful creatures summoned by Oath of Druids.

The deck focuses on playing Phyrexian Dreadnought alongside various counter spells and card draw to control the game and protect the combo. By utilizing cards like Stifle and Foil, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while assembling the pieces needed to quickly bring out the Dreadnought. With ways to dig through the deck such as Opt and Impulse, the deck can consistently find the combo pieces needed to win the game. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a powerful creature while effectively controlling the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and land denial. By using cards like Standstill, Mana Leak, and Counterspell, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. The inclusion of land destruction cards like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory further solidifies the control aspect of the deck. With a mix of removal, counters, and card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction, the deck looks to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The deck revolves around using Stifle to counter your opponent's creature abilities, while also utilizing Phyrexian Dreadnought as a powerful creature finisher. It is a fast-paced combo deck that aims to control the game with counterspells and card draw, while setting up for a quick win with Dreadnought. The deck also includes some disruption and card selection tools to help find key pieces of the combo. Overall, the strategy is to quickly assemble the Dreadnought-Stifle combo and lock down the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Enchantress's Presence to draw cards whenever you play an enchantment spell, while also utilizing cards like Sterling Grove to protect your key pieces. The deck aims to set up a board state where you can generate lots of mana with Serra's Sanctum and Wild Growth, eventually playing cards like Parallax Wave and Opalescence to create powerful combos that can overwhelm your opponent. The deck also includes some control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to handle threats and disrupt your opponent's strategy.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat that can easily overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Gush, Portent, and Vision Charm to draw into the combo pieces, while also utilizing counterspells like Foil and Counterspell to protect the combo, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and win the game with a single devastating attack. Additionally, cards like Daze and Chain of Vapor provide additional disruption and control options to help secure victory.

The deck revolves around using Hermit Druid to fill up the graveyard with creatures, then using cards like Animate Dead and Karmic Guide to bring them back for advantageous combinations. Other combo pieces include cards like Phyrexian Devourer and Triskelion for powerful effects. The deck also includes cards for mana acceleration and fixing, as well as disrupters like Cabal Therapy. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creature combinations and abilities.

The main concept of this White Weenie Aggro deck is to flood the battlefield with low-cost, aggressive creatures and quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on efficient creatures like Savannah Lions, Silver Knight, and Exalted Angel, supported by cards like Glorious Anthem to boost their power. Additional disruption is provided by cards like Swords to Plowshares and Nantuko Vigilante. The deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent, utilizing mana acceleration from Mox Diamond and land destruction from Wasteland to gain an advantage and secure a quick victory.
